responsibilities: Manages municipal services for the northern half of Dhaka including road maintenance, drainage, waste collection, street lighting, and mosquito control. Operates public markets, parks, and cemeteries within its jurisdiction. Issues birth/death certificates and trade licenses for residents and businesses in the area. Handles building approvals and urban planning coordination with RAJUK. Maintains public health standards through regular inspections and vector control programs.

Manages municipal services for the southern half of Dhaka including road maintenance, drainage, waste collection, street lighting, and mosquito control. Operates public markets, parks, and cemeteries within its jurisdiction. Issues birth/death certificates and trade licenses for residents and businesses in the area. Handles building approvals and urban planning coordination with RAJUK. Maintains public health standards through regular inspections and vector control programs.

nameEn: Dhaka Water Supply and Sewerage Authority
responsibilities: Provides potable water supply, sewerage, and storm water drainage services across Dhaka. Maintains water treatment plants, distribution pipelines, and sewerage networks. Handles complaints about water quality, low pressure, pipeline leaks, and sewerage overflow. Manages waterlogging mitigation through storm drain maintenance. Collects water bills and manages metering services for residential and commercial customers.

Distributes electricity to southern and central Dhaka areas including Dhanmondi, Motijheel, and Old Dhaka. Maintains power lines, transformers, poles, and substations. Handles outages, voltage fluctuations, billing disputes, and new connections. Manages emergency response for fallen poles and exposed wires. Coordinates with DESCO for grid stability in overlapping zones.

Distributes electricity to northern Dhaka areas including Uttara, Mirpur, Gulshan, and Banani. Maintains power lines, transformers, poles, and substations. Handles outages, voltage fluctuations, billing disputes, and new connections. Manages emergency response for fallen poles and exposed wires. Coordinates with DPDC for grid stability in overlapping zones.

nameEn: Titas Gas Transmission and Distribution Company
nameBn: তিতাস গ্যাস ট্রান্সমিশন অ্যান্ড ডিস্ট্রিবিউশন কোম্পানি
responsibilities: Transmits and distributes natural gas to residential, commercial, and industrial consumers in Dhaka and surrounding areas. Maintains gas pipelines, regulators, and metering systems. Handles gas leak emergencies, supply interruptions, low pressure complaints, and meter faults. Issues new connections and manages billing. Coordinates with Fire Service for emergency gas leak response.

Plans and regulates urban development in Dhaka including building code enforcement, land use zoning, and approval of construction plans. Handles complaints about unauthorized construction, illegal land filling, building violations, and encroachment on public land. Issues building permits and occupancy certificates. Coordinates with city corporations on infrastructure development and urban planning.

Maintains national highways, major arterial roads, and bridges in Dhaka and across Bangladesh. Handles complaints about highway potholes, road damage, bridge defects, and highway signage. Manages road widening projects and highway maintenance schedules. Coordinates with city corporations on road intersections and flyover construction. Handles traffic diversion during road repairs.

Maintains law and order, public safety, and crime prevention across Dhaka metropolitan area. Handles complaints about theft, robbery, assault, extortion, harassment, and other criminal activities. Manages police stations and emergency response through 999. Coordinates with Traffic Police on road safety and accident response. Handles missing persons reports and community policing initiatives.

Manages traffic flow, road safety, and enforcement of traffic laws in Dhaka. Handles complaints about traffic jams, illegal parking, reckless driving, broken traffic signals, and road accidents. Manages traffic signal maintenance coordination with city corporations. Handles VIP movement traffic management and event traffic control. Issues traffic fines and manages towing services.

Provides fire fighting, rescue operations, and emergency medical response across Dhaka. Handles fire incidents, building collapses, gas leak emergencies, and natural disaster response. Conducts fire safety inspections and issues fire safety certificates. Manages emergency evacuation and disaster preparedness training. Coordinates with police and medical services during major incidents.

Monitors and enforces environmental standards including air quality, noise pollution, water pollution, and hazardous waste management. Handles complaints about industrial pollution, noise from factories or events, illegal dumping, and environmental violations. Issues environmental clearance certificates for projects. Manages river and lake pollution control initiatives. Coordinates with city corporations on waste management and green initiatives.
